name: @athanlab/mcp

tools.name: athanlab_list_voices
tools.description: Lists the voices this API key can speak with: AthanLab's official Burmese voices (source "athanlab") and the voices in the account's own library (source "user"), plus default_voice_id — the voice used when a speech call names none. Call this first to pick a voice_id for athanlab_speak / athanlab_speak_script. Free; read-only.

tools.name: athanlab_preview_voice
tools.description: Returns a signed URL of a short sample of one voice (valid about an hour; no API key needed to play it), so the user can hear a voice before choosing it. With save: true the sample is also downloaded into the output directory. Free. Files are written to /pkg/athanlab-audio.

save.description: Also download the sample into the output directory.

tools.name: athanlab_quote
tools.description: Validates a text exactly as athanlab_speak would and returns what it would cost — without creating a job or charging anything. Returns characters (the exact charge: UTF-16 length), dispatches (how many pieces the text is split into), spendable (the account's balance now) and sufficient. Use it before long texts, or to check that a text will be accepted (it surfaces unspeakable_text, text_too_long and voice_not_found errors for free).

text.description: Burmese text to speak, 1–5,000 characters (UTF-16 units: an emoji counts 2). Write Burmese script, end sentences with ။ ! or ?. See the athanlab-writing-guide.

voice_id.description: A voice id from athanlab_list_voices. Leave it out to use the API default voice.

number_mode.description: How digits are read: smart (default: Burmese digits as words, Latin digits as written), place (all digits as Burmese place words), digits (Burmese, one digit at a time — phone numbers), english (English number words), english_digits (English, one digit at a time).

tools.name: athanlab_speak
tools.description: Turns one Burmese text (up to 5,000 characters) into an audio file and returns its path. COSTS the text's length in characters from the account balance (failed jobs are refunded). Creates an asynchronous job, waits for it (usually seconds to a few minutes) and downloads the audio. If it does not finish within timeout_seconds the job keeps running: the result has status "processing" and the job_id — then use athanlab_get_job / athanlab_download_audio and do NOT call athanlab_speak again for the same text (that would pay twice). For dialogue or many lines, use athanlab_speak_script. Read the athanlab-writing-guide first. Files are written to /pkg/athanlab-audio.

text.description: Burmese text to speak, 1–5,000 characters (UTF-16 units: an emoji counts 2). Write Burmese script, end sentences with ။ ! or ?. See the athanlab-writing-guide.

voice_id.description: A voice id from athanlab_list_voices. Leave it out to use the API default voice.

output_format.description: wav (default; exact, for editing) or mp3 (smaller).

number_mode.description: How digits are read: smart (default: Burmese digits as words, Latin digits as written), place (all digits as Burmese place words), digits (Burmese, one digit at a time — phone numbers), english (English number words), english_digits (English, one digit at a time).

filename.description: Optional file name (no folders: only the last path segment is used, the extension is forced to the format). Written inside the server's output directory; never overwrites — an existing name gets a suffix.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for the job before returning its job_id instead (default 900).

idempotency_key.description: Only to retry a call that failed with an unknown outcome (network error): pass the idempotency_key from that error so the same text is never charged twice. Leave it out otherwise.

tools.name: athanlab_speak_script
tools.description: Generates a dialogue or script line by line: one audio file per line (named from the line's id or speaker and its position) plus manifest.json with every line on one timeline — consecutive lines of the same speaker are separated by gaps.sentence seconds, a speaker change by gaps.turn — and optionally combined.wav (combine: true, WAV only). Each line's voice is its voice_id, else voices[speaker], else the default voice. COSTS the characters of every new line. It quotes all lines first (free); above 2,000 characters or 20 lines it returns the quote WITHOUT creating anything unless confirm is true — show the quote to the user, then call again with confirm: true. RESUMABLE: re-running the same call (same lines and out_subdir) skips finished lines and follows running jobs without paying again; changing one line's text regenerates only that line; a line whose earlier audio is gone (deleted after 30 days) is quoted and charged again like a new line. Run ONE call per out_subdir at a time: a second call on the same folder while one is running returns script_running and does nothing. Stops creating jobs on plan_required, insufficient_characters or key_budget_exceeded and reports which lines are done. Files are written to /pkg/athanlab-audio.

id.description: Your label for the line (used in its file name).

speaker.description: Who speaks it; maps to a voice through `voices`.

text.description: One sentence-sized line of Burmese text.

voice_id.description: A voice id from athanlab_list_voices. Leave it out to use the API default voice.

sentence.description: Seconds between consecutive lines of the same speaker (default 0.4).

output_format.description: wav (default) or mp3. combine needs wav.

number_mode.description: How digits are read: smart (default: Burmese digits as words, Latin digits as written), place (all digits as Burmese place words), digits (Burmese, one digit at a time — phone numbers), english (English number words), english_digits (English, one digit at a time).

combine.description: Also write combined.wav: every line joined on the timeline with silent gaps (WAV only).

confirm.description: Required above 2,000 characters or 20 lines; otherwise only the quote is returned.

out_subdir.description: Folder (inside the output directory) for this script. Reuse it to resume or to regenerate changed lines; defaults to a name derived from the script.

timeout_seconds.description: Stop waiting after this long (default 900); running jobs continue and a re-run picks them up.

tools.name: athanlab_get_job
tools.description: Returns one speech job: status (processing, succeeded, failed, cancelled), progress, characters charged and refunded, audio duration and expiry, and the failure reason. Use it to check on a job returned by a timed-out athanlab_speak. Free; read-only.

job_id.description: The job id (32 lowercase hex characters) from athanlab_speak, athanlab_list_jobs or a timeout result.

tools.name: athanlab_list_jobs
tools.description: Lists the account's speech jobs, newest first (all keys of the account share one history). Filter by status; page with cursor (the previous page's next_cursor). Use status "processing" to find jobs still running. Free; read-only.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page, unchanged.

tools.name: athanlab_cancel_job
tools.description: Stops a job that is still processing. The part already generated stays charged; the rest is refunded (characters_refunded). Cancelling an already cancelled job returns it again; a finished job cannot be cancelled (job_finished). Works even when the key is read-only.

job_id.description: The job id (32 lowercase hex characters) from athanlab_speak, athanlab_list_jobs or a timeout result.

tools.name: athanlab_download_audio
tools.description: Saves the audio of a succeeded job to a file and returns its path — for jobs from a timed-out athanlab_speak, from athanlab_list_jobs, or to get the other format (a job made as wav can be downloaded as mp3 and vice versa). Free (the job was paid when created). Audio is kept 30 days after the job was created. Files are written to /pkg/athanlab-audio.

job_id.description: The job id (32 lowercase hex characters) from athanlab_speak, athanlab_list_jobs or a timeout result.

format.description: wav or mp3; defaults to the job's own format.

filename.description: Optional file name (no folders: only the last path segment is used, the extension is forced to the format). Written inside the server's output directory; never overwrites — an existing name gets a suffix.

tools.name: athanlab_usage
tools.description: Returns the account's character balance and API limits: plan, whether this key may create jobs (entitled — false means read-only: Max plan or founder access needed), the monthly allowance and when it resets, Athan Tokens, spendable (monthly remaining + tokens), jobs running now against max_concurrent_jobs, and this key's monthly budget. Free; read-only.

instructions:
AthanLab turns Burmese (Myanmar) text into natural speech.
Workflow: athanlab_list_voices to pick a voice → athanlab_quote (free) for anything long → athanlab_speak for one text, or athanlab_speak_script for dialogue and multi-line scripts (one file per line plus a timeline manifest).
Speaking COSTS characters from the account balance: 1 per UTF-16 unit (an emoji counts 2); quotes, reads and downloads are free; failed jobs are refunded.
Before writing text, read the athanlab-writing-guide (prompt, or resource athanlab://guides/writing): Burmese script only, end sentences with ။ ! or ?, no emoji-only text, choose number_mode for digits.
A speak call that times out returns a job_id: resume with athanlab_get_job / athanlab_download_audio — never repeat athanlab_speak for the same text, which would pay twice. Re-running athanlab_speak_script with the same arguments resumes it — one call per out_subdir at a time, never two in parallel.
Stop and tell the user on plan_required (Max plan or founder access needed), insufficient_characters (top up or wait for the monthly reset) and key_budget_exceeded (raise the key budget); these are never retried.
Audio files are written to /pkg/athanlab-audio.
